question: Should Commerce retain any public reference to a private fork for this pilot, or defer mounted-site support until the upstream fix is released?
rationale: The repository policy forbids private repository coordinates, while the proposed contract relies on one for mounted-site runtime behavior.

options.title: Wait for the stable upstream release
options.body: Remove the private-fork contract and enable mounted-site support only after a released EmDash version passes the required proof.

options.title: Reject fork-backed mounted-site support
options.body: Keep the storage-only catalog work but exclude mounted-site runtime support until a public supported baseline exists.
